name: scale
_deep_note: Returns deep (deep_bell): dragonscale scale mail and the deep metals. Brandon's defence-model decision 20 (2026-11-17): a Dexterity hero finds light and medium armour all the way down; it keeps the template's lower AC (the trade for the dodge and the speed).
lore_template: Like the scales of a fish, the {material_name} plates in this coat overlap upon a backing of leather, each lashed in its place. A point slides down them and away, though a thrust from below may still lift one.
forms_note: Overlapping metal sheds a cut and turns most points; a hammer still bruises through.
